slot.brief: Find the work done / projection of one vector on another using dot product with given magnitudes and angle.

stem: Vectors of magnitudes $8$ and $5$ make an angle of $60^\\circ$. What is the scalar projection of the first vector on the second?
working:
Scalar projection $=|\vec a|\cos\theta=8\cos60^\circ=4$.

Independent check: Scalar projection = |a| cos 60° = 8 × 0.5 = 4.
solution:
The scalar projection of the first vector on the second is $|\vec a|\cos\theta$.
$$8\cos60^\circ=8\left(\frac12\right)=4$$
